articles.title: Active Inference as Context Acquisition for AI Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19202v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Interactive AI agents must acquire the right context as efficiently as possible. When a user omits a constraint, preference, file, or task variable, an agent can proceed with a default assumption or spend tokens on a clarifying question, retrieval call, tool call, or prompt trial. We formulate this tradeoff as active inference for context acquisition. An inner inference step updates beliefs over a latent task state, and an outer decision selects the next context action, task action, or stop action to minimize expected free energy under cost. In deterministic settings, the epistemic term reduces to expected information gain, optionally normalized by token cost. We instantiate the framework in Optimal Question Asking (OQA), with exact posteriors and a dynamic programming oracle, and benchmark frontier language models on binary and multiway categorical tasks from 25 to 300 candidates. articles.title: How to Navigate Uncertainty About AI Consciousness
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19215v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Given deep uncertainty about the possibility of artificial consciousness, it is unclear how we should treat potentially sentient AI. On the one hand, we could assume insentience but risk doing terrible harms to entities that deserve moral standing. On the other hand, we could assume sentience and instead risk wasting resources on insentient machines. The intractability of questions around AI consciousness mean that this dilemma is hard to escape. I suggest a way out of that shifts from intractable questions of AI consciousness to tractable questions of AI valence. Specifically, we can assess whether an AI has states that would constitute valenced experiences if it were conscious. I show how this is sufficient to ground a responsible approach to the development of potentially conscious AI.

articles.title: Bounded Sovereignty and the Control Tax: Pricing AI Oversight When the Deployer Does Not Own the Model
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19216v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI control research asks how to deploy models safely even when they may be misaligned, but many control protocols assume that the deployer can instrument the model and its surrounding pipeline. That assumption often fails for regulated organisations using frontier models through APIs or managed endpoints, where the deployer may control the business process but not the model weights, serving infrastructure, internal traces, update process, or full interaction logs. articles.title: Beyond Imitation: Filtering On-Policy Distillation by Reasoning Progress
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19408v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective framework for post-training language models by pairing student-generated trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a teacher. However, OPD implicitly assumes that teacher-derived rewards are an appropriate proxy for reasoning progress, and therefore treats all teacher feedback equally during policy optimization. While in practice, this assumption does not always hold. We observe that teacher-derived rewards often conflict with genuine reasoning progress, as reasoning steps with clear reasoning advancement may still receive lower distillation rewards, simply due to deviation from teacher's outputs. To address this mismatch, we propose Reasoning-Progress-Aware Reward Filtering for On-Policy Distillation (R2-OPD), which constructs two within-trajectory rankings of reasoning spans, one from teacher-derived rewards and the other from independently estimated progress reward. articles.content:

Abstract: Symposium is a formal framework and practical implementation to record the operation of AI agents deployed by small scientific research communities. Symposium provides long-term, immutable histories of agent-driven research activity, leaving auditable trails of analyses, hypotheses, data, and scientific discourse. Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language-model responses by grounding generation in external passages, which comes with overhead: retrieved context lengthens the prompt, increasing prefill work, KV-cache footprint, memory traffic, latency, and energy. Context compression offers a natural remedy by pruning retrieved text before generation. However, state-of-the-art context-compression methods are typically used with a fixed compression budget, or with the rate selected offline and then applied at inference time. Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications, yet their tendency to generate toxic, harmful, or policy-violating content poses significant risks. articles.title: Can Agent Memory Systems Track Evolving State?
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19652v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As LLM-based agents are deployed for longer and higher-stakes tasks, their memory systems continue to have crucial gaps. Abstract: Smart contract vulnerability detection with Large Language Models (LLMs) faces three causally linked challenges. First, new vulnerability categories demand parameter-efficient adaptation, since full retraining is prohibitive for sequentially arriving tasks. Abstract: Vision-language-model-based embodied agents can complete instructed tasks but often violate safety constraints in the process, a problem recently framed as interactive safety. articles.title: Improved Confidence Estimates for Black-Box Large Language Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.19323v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for the safe deployment of large language models (LLMs). Existing methods, from verbalized confidence to ones requiring multiple generations, are often zero-shot and produce scores quantifying uncertainty without the need for labelled data. Nonetheless, in practice one must always evaluate their performance on a dataset of interest before deployment. In this work we show that, by leveraging this dataset, we consistently outperform these existing scores. Specifically, we build simple classifiers that predict LLM response correctness by using these scores and the correctness of similar queries as features. Our method produces minimal computational overhead, making it a cheap and straightforward enhancement for UQ in LLMs for real-world applications.

Abstract: Text summarization refers to the task of condensing a document into a shorter version while preserving its key information. ATS methods are commonly categorized by input type (such as single-document or multi-document summarization) and by output type (extractive, abstractive, and hybrid). Abstract: Historical Arabic manuscript transcription is not only a recognition problem. 击掌，左下角还有类似掌机按键的设计，与其游戏主题定位契合。整个前面板的设计融入了萌宠元素、视觉交互和按键交互，装饰俏皮但不花哨，并充分利用错落层次丰富质感。下面我们再深入看看 COLORFIRE ME26A 橘舍机箱的内部构造和功能性如何。前面板采用榫卯固定方案，支持免工具徒手拆装，大幅降低了用户加装前置风扇、清灰维护的操作门槛，同时榫卯结构也与原木风格的设计语言形成了内在呼应。机箱顶部配备大尺寸磁吸防尘网，表面融入猫爪涟漪纹理与系列主题文字，在俯视视角下形成“橘猫趴卧”的视觉联想，进一步强化了 IP 主题的沉浸感。当然，磁吸防尘网一提就起，长期使用后也方便各位“铲屎官”清理。揭开顶部防尘网可以看到，顶部空间被分成了左右 3 个区域，右侧 CNC 蜂窝开孔留给冷排散热，左侧有一个专属的电源仓顶盖，拧下螺丝取掉顶盖，将电源按键面朝上，无需踮脚弯腰去够机箱背部，就能轻松开关电源或调整电源风扇模式。打开机箱后侧，这个专属电源仓空间相当大，兼容所有体积的主流电源，右侧的白色电源延长线一直连到机箱尾部，内部预留分层框架与螺丝孔位，便于电源稳固安装；剩下的实心区域则留给主板防尘。机箱底部也配备了全覆盖的磁吸防尘网，左侧区域的蜂窝 CNC articles.content: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，在今天的 2026 成都车展现场，小鹏汽车官方宣布，截至当前，小鹏 X9 全球累计交付量突破 60,000 台，7 月份斩获香港、泰国豪华纯电 MPV 销量第一。小鹏今日也推出了小鹏 X9 黑武士套件，售价 8,800 元，包含极夜黑全新车色、星舰尾翼、星刃运动轮毂，所有版本均可选装。其中星舰尾翼也可单独选装，售价 1,298 元。IT之家注：2026 款小鹏 X9 纯电版 MPV 车型于今年 3 月上市，号称全球续航最长 5C 纯电大七座，售价 30.98 万元起。该车可选极光青、星云紫、星云白、星舰灰 (哑光)、暗夜黑、新月银等六款外观配色，尺寸为 5316×1988×1785mm、轴距 3160mm，配有 235kW 电机，零百加速 7.7 秒。该车宣称是“全球续航最长 5C 纯电大七座”，全系标配 5C 超充，CLTC 续航可达 750km，综合电耗百公里 15.9kWh；标配三排电动“三折叠”座椅，可形成 4/5/6/7 座的多种布局，同时配备安全气囊的零重力座椅也是全系标配，可 180° 躺平，并具有 180mm“同级最宽”中央过道。新车还全系标配主动式后轮转向，最小转弯半径 5.4m，配备智能双腔空悬、标配爆胎稳行系统。智能化方面，2026 款小鹏 X9 纯电版全系标配图灵芯片，最高有效算力可达 2250TOPS，AEB 最高车速提升至 130km/h。

articles.title: 消息称某厂子系骁龙 8E6 超级版小平板搭载方形 Deco、风扇，预计为 iQOO 旗下
articles.content: IT之家 8 月 21 日消息，博主 @数码闲聊站 今日爆料，某厂子系骁龙 8E6 超级版小平板搭载 2.8K OLED 超高刷屏幕，采用四窄边设计、一体金属中框、方形 Deco，并且 Deco 有风扇。结合该博主此前的爆料习惯，预计这款新品为 iQOO 旗下。目前，今日曝光高通两款骁龙 2nm 旗舰芯片正式命名已经曝光：SM8950—Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen6—— 第六代骁龙 8 至尊版SM8975——Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen6—— 第六代骁龙 8 超级至尊版IT之家注意到，vivo 目前的旗舰平板均为大屏产品，例如 vivo Pad6 Pro / iQOO Pad6 Pro，这两款产品均搭载 13.2 英寸 4K 性能巨幕、第五代骁龙 8 至尊版处理器，支持全新超感触控、游戏超分等功能。▲ iQOO Pad6 Pro从目前曝光的消息看，iQOO 新品小平板有望延续现款产品的电竞表现。
